full_prompt_en: A square fantasy landscape painting opens onto a rocky green valley under an immense blue sky. Thick white cumulus clouds pile high across the upper half, their sunlit rounded tops contrasting with cool gray undersides. At the center, a monumental elephant-shaped stone form emerges from a wooded rise. Its long curved tusk and lowered trunk project toward the left, while an ornate golden-beige tower and smaller domed structures appear built into or mounted upon its back. Large dark trees spread behind the tower, their crowns nearly merging with the building and emphasizing its strange scale. The elephant form is partly hidden by boulders and shrubs, making animal, rock and architecture seem intergrown. A smaller living elephant stands on an open patch near the far left waterline, helping establish the huge size of the central structure. Tiny figures gather along the warm sandy path below it. Far mountains and pale blue water recede into the left distance. The foreground is a band of shadowed rocks and low scrub, with brighter ochre ground leading inward. Fine painted detail describes masonry, rugged stone and clustered leaves, while the clouds are rendered in broad, soft masses. Light arrives from the upper left, lifting the cloud tops and warm carved surfaces, and leaving deep green-brown shade beneath the trees and stone body. The space moves from a dark near ledge through the astonishing central landmark to an airy, open horizon. The composition uses a low viewpoint and exaggerated scale, but the textures and atmospheric distance give the impossible structure a grounded landscape presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻风景画展开一条崎岖的绿色山谷，上方是广阔蓝天。厚重白色积云在上半幅层层高叠，受光的圆顶与冷灰云底相对。中央，一座巨大的象形石构从林木覆盖的高地上出现。它弯曲的长牙和垂下的象鼻伸向左边，一座华丽的金米色高塔与较小圆顶建筑似乎筑在或架在它背上。高塔后方大树舒展开来，树冠几乎与建筑融在一起，强化奇异尺度。象形体部分被巨石和灌木遮挡，让动物、岩石和建筑似乎相互生长。左侧近水的空地上还有一只较小的活象，为中央构造的巨大尺寸提供参照。细小人物聚在其下的暖沙色道路上。远山与浅蓝水面退向左边远方。前景是一道处在阴影中的岩石和矮灌木，较亮的赭色地面引导视线向内。细腻绘画细节描出砌体、粗岩和密集树叶，云朵则由宽大柔软的团块绘成。光从左上方来到，抬亮云顶和温暖雕刻面，在树下与石象身体下留下深绿褐阴影。空间从深色近岸经过惊人的中央地标，走向通透开阔的地平线。构图采用低视点与夸张尺度，但肌理和空气纵深让不可能的结构在风景中有了落地的存在感。
style_prompt_en: The image has a detailed fantasy landscape painting surface that joins finely articulated near textures to broad, softly modeled atmospheric masses. Deep blue and luminous white occupy a large upper area, while olive green, warm stone and earthy brown form compact layers below. Strong size contrast turns one clustered central silhouette into a monumental anchor and lets tiny marks establish scale. Rounded organic masses interweave with carved, vertical geometry, blurring their boundaries through shared texture and shadow. Cloud edges are billowy and light, while lower edges are rough, broken and densely worked. Sunlight lifts exposed warm planes and white volumes; deep cool shade gathers underneath overlapping forms. The viewpoint sits low enough to make the central rise imposing, yet the open horizon keeps the scene expansive. Dark foreground weight leads into a brighter middle route and then distant blue haze. The overall rhythm alternates intricacy and open air, grounding unusual forms in consistent natural light and painted material.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细节丰富的奇幻风景绘画表面，把近处仔细刻画的肌理与宽大柔塑的空气团块连接起来。深蓝与发亮白色占据大块上方区域，橄榄绿、暖石色和土褐在下方压成紧凑层次。强烈的尺寸对比使中央聚集的剪影成为巨大的锚点，极细小的笔痕则建立尺度。圆润有机团块与雕刻般竖向几何交织，凭共同肌理和阴影模糊边界。云边松软明亮，下方边缘则粗粝、破碎且密集加工。日光抬亮暴露的暖色平面和白色体积；深冷阴影聚在层叠形体下方。视点足够低，使中央隆起显得巍峨，开放地平线又保留场景的宽展。深色前景重量引向更亮的中间路径，再走入远方蓝雾。整体节奏在繁复与开阔空气间交替，以一致自然光和绘画材质让奇异形体站稳。
theme_en: A monumental elephant-shaped stone structure carries ornate towers among trees beneath towering white clouds
theme_zh: 一座巨大的象形石构托着华丽塔楼，立于树木之间和高耸白云之下
name: Ferdinand Knab
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
